name: Saigo ni Mita Tenshi
source:
The girl was sick.
The girl was bored every day.
The girl wanted to talk to someone.
The girl met an angel.

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19317]Freem![/url]]
translation:
少女体弱多病。

少女每天都很无聊。

少女想找个人说说话。

少女遇见了天使。

[摘自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19317]Freem![/url]]
